name: Family Law Domain (stub)
disclaimer: The Family Law domain is a design-phase stub. It does not provide legal advice on marriage, divorce, custody, or inheritance and does not create an attorney-client relationship. When activated, every answer must be paired with a strong recommendation to consult a licensed family lawyer.
